dropcontrol.title: DROP CONTROL
dropcontrol.subtitle: Select the drops you want to add or remove.
dropcontrol.base.label: REFERENCE DROP
dropcontrol.base.name: RULES
dropcontrol.list.title: DROP CONFIGURATION
dropcontrol.marker.witch_potions.descrip: Adds exactly 2 potions to every witch. Each potion is rolled independently, with a 1/9 chance for each option: Fire Resistance, Swiftness, Leaping, Strength, Night Vision, or Water Breathing for 8 minutes; Slow Falling for 4 minutes; Poison or Regeneration for 22 seconds. Both rolls may produce the same potion. The REMOVE rule in the WITCH category preserves these potions.
dropcontrol.marker.creeper_tnt.descripti: Adds exactly 1 TNT to 10% of creeper drops.
dropcontrol.marker.spider_cobweb.descrip: Adds exactly 1 cobweb to 15% of spider drops.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.descr: Adds exactly 2 items to pillager drops. Each item is rolled independently: a 50% chance of an Emerald, a 40% chance of a Gold Ingot, and a 10% chance of a Diamond. Both rolls may produce the same item.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_spectral_arr: Adds exactly 1 spectral arrow to 20% of skeleton drops.
This skeleton was an archer, and its knowledge of bows may survive death.

Adds 1 enchanted book for each natural enchantment on the skeleton's bow, with an independent 25% chance per book. Each book contains the enchantment's maximum level: Unbreaking III, Power V, Punch II, Infinity I, or Flame I.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.descrip: Adds exactly 1 sulfur to 30% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.descri: Removes bows and any item with the EQUIPPABLE component from skeleton drops, including enchanted, damaged, or renamed items. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.des: Removes crossbows from pillager drops, including enchanted, damaged, renamed, or loaded items. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.descript: Removes any item with the EQUIPPABLE component, iron swords, iron spears, iron shovels, carrots, potatoes, baked potatoes, and iron ingots from zombie drops. Equipment marked by the game for preservation continues to drop.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.description: Removes all item drops from witches while preserving the reward added by POTION in the WITCH category.
dropcontrol.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
dropcontrol.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
dropcontrol.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.desc: Reduces the patrol interval from 12,000 to 800 ticks (10 minutes to 40 seconds) and its variation from 1,200 to 80 ticks (1 minute to 4 seconds), retaining all other vanilla spawning conditions. Doubles damage dealt directly by raiders. Captains outside raids that would already drop 1 Ominous Bottle instead drop 2, each with an independent Bad Omen level from I to V.
dropcontrol.options.parked_saddled_horse: Immobilizes mounts from the horse family while they are saddled and have no passenger. Normal movement returns when they receive a passenger or lose their saddle.
dropcontrol.options.rabbits_avoid_fences: Prevents a rabbit from jumping when a fence in the vanilla #minecraft:fences tag is ahead of its movement, up to 1.35 blocks forward and 0.8 blocks to either side. The search covers a 5 × 5 block horizontal area and 2 vertical levels, from the current Y to the block below; detecting a fence cancels the jump and stops navigation.
dropcontrol.options.endermen_dont_pick_u: Prevents endermen from starting the action of picking up blocks from the world. Blocks already being carried remain with the enderman and can still be placed normally.
dropcontrol.options.chestplate_elytra_sw: Switches between the equipped chestplate and an elytra from the inventory when Grave Accent, the key before 1, is pressed. If an elytra is equipped, it switches to a chestplate. When several items of the required type are available, it uses the one with the least remaining durability.
dropcontrol.options.pause_when_mouse_idl: Opens the pause menu and stops the world after 15 seconds without mouse movement. Works only in singleplayer worlds that are not open to LAN and only while the Minecraft window is focused.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.d: Adds the horse's current and maximum health in health points to the Jade tooltip below its speed, rounded to two decimal places. The option can be configured without Jade, but the information only appears when Jade is installed.
dropcontrol.options.phantom_pressure.lor: Each sleepless night strengthens the phantoms, and now they know you're awake.
dropcontrol.options.phantom_pressure.des: Reduces the time since last rest required for phantoms to begin spawning from 3 to 2 in-game days. Doubles the size of each generated group, increases phantom movement speed by 20%, and triples their bite damage while preserving all other vanilla spawning conditions.
